observation.command:
echo "================ FINAL VERIFICATION ================"
echo "--- Running processes ---"
pg_lsclusters | grep online
rabbitmqctl status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "RabbitMQ version|Uptime" | head -2
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":9000|:8080|:18080|:18081|:18082|:5432" | awk '{print $4}' | sort -u
echo
echo "--- OGC services (via Apache :8080) ---"
for u in "xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs41?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs50?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs51?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs52?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs60?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs-syn/services/xplansynwfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities"; do
  c=$(timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/$u"); echo "  $c  /$u"
done
echo "--- Web apps & APIs ---"
for u in "xplan-manager-web/" "xplan-validator-web/" "xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-validator-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-dokumente-api/swagger-ui/index.html" ""; do
  c=$(timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/$u"); echo "  $c  /$u"
done
echo "--- S3 buckets ---"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xplanbox AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3 ls | head -5
echo "--- DB schemas ---"
su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -t -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name NOT IN (\'pg_catalog\',\'pg_toast\',\'information_schema\');'"
